valor: David, a six-year-old Black boy, is bullied at school for the color of his skin and his missing teeth. When he is asked for a school photo, he hides it from his parents to avoid more teasing. But his great-grandfather Leandro finds out and makes him false teeth out of yuca. Together, they get ready for the photo.
motivo: síntesis 26 nov (redactor 3 26 nov; verifica verificador 3 26 nov): equivale a la corta en español
